ended: Made the whole map harsher: the river is now a trickle (2.2 blocks/s, was 3.6), droughts leave less water behind, there is more badwater (about twice as much as clean water now), and there are a quarter fewer trees and 30% fewer berry bushes. Trade-off: every reservoir fills more slowly. Your own features stay. Assumption: "harder" means harsher land and water; I did not change the difficulty the map is designed for (normal). Say if you want it designed for hard instead, which tightens the start rules. Every start rule still holds.
